authority: Subordinate implementation requirements under CURRENT_PLAN.md, NEXT_MILESTONE.json and ENGINEERING_EXIT_CONTRACTS.json; not another queue, evidence registry or acceptance authority.
change_rule: Each implementation updates the existing owning module/topic, actual tests and source/evidence mapping. This file does not make proposed APIs, tests or budgets implemented, Ready or Accepted.

priorities.title: Security defects and current authority
implementation_steps: Apply explicit non-traversing App Debug to canonical and diagnostic processes; preserve credential handling and wire behavior except approved drain authentication precedence.
Add native normal/pretty/nested redaction and drain authorization-negative regressions in both targets.
Rebind current milestone, integration gap and evidence pending requirement through the existing CURRENT_STATE authority; update only the reviewed roadmap scope pin, not evidence eligibility.
Retain old evidence and all required task/gap/test/reviewer obligations. Verify the new exact head and actual prospective merge before ordinary protected admission.
acceptance_outputs: native unit tests and strict lint
independent source/governance acceptance and post-merge retained bytes

priorities.title: Service, persistence and recovery contracts
implementation_steps: Extract shared typed service/repository commands and results without importing concrete PG or wire types into domain contracts; retain the one default composition root.
For each of the seven integration seams record exact inputs/results, error effects, transaction boundaries, total deadline, recovery and named failure tests.
Reuse and qualify existing durable refresh, cursor, cancellation and outbox source; new abstractions must preserve all existing regression cases.
Publish the authoritative data dictionary and separate PostgreSQL/CockroachDB behavior before schema changes.
acceptance_outputs: both-profile live transaction and fault packets
no wire or schema change without approved compatibility/migration decision

priorities.title: One accepted official-client vertical slice
implementation_steps: Choose exact mandatory authentication/session/storage leaves and a supported official client; freeze immutable oracle, fixtures and profile.
Run client -> official adapter -> trusted service -> durable transaction -> receipt/outbox -> retry/restart/reconnect on PostgreSQL first.
Observe raw wire and database effects; do not use custom authority endpoints or mock verifiers as official compatibility proof.
Retain complete artifact bytes and obtain independent acceptance for this limited scope; repeat separately on CockroachDB without transferring credit.
acceptance_outputs: accepted narrow-scope evidence through existing admission
separate CockroachDB profile before its claim

priorities.title: Full domain detailed design and implementation
implementation_steps: Complete the eight design dimensions for all eleven existing domain work packages and the module follow-ups below.
Bind every interface to actual upstream leaves, owners, fixtures and resource budgets; satisfy CURRENT_PLAN Definition of Ready before broad implementation.
Implement bounded vertical changes per domain, including errors, durable effects, official consumers and recovery, not merely in-memory success paths.
Preserve the complete Nakama denominator and separate native hardening/extensions from exact compatibility.
acceptance_outputs: all 23 module follow-ups resolved in existing module docs
official wire/runtime/SDK and database differential per scope

priorities.title: Capacity, recovery and production qualification
implementation_steps: Approve numerical workload/hardware/topology, tail-latency/error/cost, memory/queue/pool, RPO and RTO objectives before measuring a passing capacity claim.
Reuse existing recovery/failover/endurance harnesses; add application-level authority/route/outbox fencing during failures and test clone/history/high-water costs under maximum churn.
Execute actual 24h/72h/7d durations with continuous correctness assertions; segments cannot hide gaps, restarts, source changes or missing elapsed execution.
Perform no-effect shadow, exclusive canary and rollback rehearsal; production, cutover and retirement require separately authenticated decisions and durable anti-replay.
acceptance_outputs: separate measured PostgreSQL/CockroachDB recovery and HA

integration_seams.contract: Authenticate issuer/provider/project/user/session before constructing trusted service context. Fingerprints derive from complete canonical operation data, never caller assertions.
integration_seams.required_failure_cases: Forged or disabled identity; wrong project/profile; stale session; no mutation.

integration_seams.contract: Separate security-transition commit from public error. Reuse exact durable successor replay only under its existing authenticated identity and profile contract.
integration_seams.required_failure_cases: Simultaneous refresh/logout; commit-before-response crash; changed successor; revocation survives authentication Err.

integration_seams.contract: Authenticate full cursor scope and position; define concurrent mutation semantics and preserve exact public MD5/integrity separation.
integration_seams.required_failure_cases: Cross-actor/project/profile cursor, tamper, page deletion/insertion, ACL-before-limit, same-key owner ordering.

integration_seams.contract: Shared typed commands/results and one deadline; adapters own SQL/retry/receipt reconciliation.
integration_seams.required_failure_cases: Pool saturation, stale generation, cancellation and uncertain commit; no fabricated success or blind retry.

integration_seams.contract: Immutable payload and stable idempotency identity; authenticated outcome queries and explicit indeterminate/quarantine states.
integration_seams.required_failure_cases: Provider success with lost response; dead last lease; stale owner; repeated receipt without duplicate visible effect.

integration_seams.contract: Persist revocation generation and checkpoint before admitting routes; bounded fanout reaches actual sockets.
integration_seams.required_failure_cases: Restart, delayed old namespace, reconnect storm and full retained high-water capacity.

integration_seams.contract: Supervise mandatory children and separate liveness from dependency readiness; one cancellation/drain tree.
integration_seams.required_failure_cases: Stop admission before drain acknowledgement; worker death; stalled synchronous child; bounded recovery.

design_deliverables.scope-and-dependencies: Own provider assertion verification, account lifecycle, link/unlink and session issuance through a trusted service context. Reuse identity/session cores; never let provider identifiers stand in for authentication.
design_deliverables.public-api-and-examples: Bind create/no-create, authenticate, update, link, unlink, disable and delete to exact pinned API leaves. Retain valid, collision, wrong-audience and inactive-account request/response examples; document provider-specific case and normalization rules.
design_deliverables.state-and-data: Define account/provider uniqueness, retirement tombstones, revision, receipt operation identity and session-family rows. Specify the durable write set and reverse-index constraints before proposing any migration.
design_deliverables.errors-and-side-effects: Enumerate validation/authorization/collision/revision precedence. Separate no-mutation errors from replay-triggered revocation that must commit despite an authentication error. Never expose account-existence diagnostics publicly.
design_deliverables.concurrency-and-recovery: Reuse and verify the existing durable refresh response-loss implementation before changing it. Specify authenticated exact-operation replay, conflicting successor revocation, simultaneous refresh/logout, crash-after-commit and multi-node ownership fencing.
design_deliverables.security-and-budgets: Bind issuer, audience, provider app, nonce, project and profile. Declare provider timeout, per-actor admission, payload/receipt/history limits and safe expiry; do not evict still-replayable identities to free capacity.
design_deliverables.tests-and-compatibility: Require provider hostile fixtures, disabled-account replay, cross-operation receipt reuse, refresh response-loss/replay/logout races and official-client wire/database differential on both profiles.
design_deliverables.operations-and-change: Publish provider degradation, rotation/revoke and recovery procedures; define export/deletion/tombstone retention and audit visibility. Preserve one session-family writer through migration.

design_deliverables.scope-and-dependencies: Own friends/blocks, groups, direct/group/room chat and notifications. Authenticate user status/project before calling bounded social core; separate persistence from fanout and push providers.
design_deliverables.public-api-and-examples: For every operation retain exact generated request/response examples, permission and cursor scope. Distinguish open join, approval join, role changes, last-superadmin rules and all three chat kinds.
design_deliverables.state-and-data: Define relationship/reverse-index, membership/pending/ban, message sequence, receipt and immutable delivery-payload ownership. Commit domain state, receipt and outbox intents together.
design_deliverables.errors-and-side-effects: Publish a role-by-action authorization matrix and error precedence. Blocking removes incompatible relationships atomically; retries of exact commands cannot duplicate message or notification effects.
design_deliverables.concurrency-and-recovery: Define simultaneous accept/block, leave/demotion, duplicate chat, notify-then-delete and crash-before/after-delivery cases. Workers consume original committed payloads, not reconstructed mutable state.
design_deliverables.security-and-budgets: Declare per-group membership, payload, history, outbox, fanout and receipt budgets. Authenticate cursor owner/group/project; redact message text and preserve private-history visibility after status changes.
design_deliverables.tests-and-compatibility: Require cross-actor and cross-operation replay negatives, ACL history queries, identical outbox payload replay, per-profile transaction faults, official RTAPI/SDK differences and node-reconnect scenarios.
design_deliverables.operations-and-change: Define moderation/export/deletion, retention and replay catch-up. Alert on sequence gaps, delivery ambiguity and saturated queues; document quarantine and safe replay without duplicate user-visible effects.

design_deliverables.scope-and-dependencies: Own exact-value storage, ACL/OCC/batch/list/search services. Keep public MD5 ContentVersion separate from internal SHA-256 corruption detection and from authenticated cursor protection.
design_deliverables.public-api-and-examples: Publish field and byte limits, owner/server actor rules, blind/create-only/exact-version conditions, error precedence and full authenticated cursor format. Preserve exact upstream encoding through oracle review.
design_deliverables.state-and-data: Describe authoritative columns/constraints/indexes and key ordering for collection, object key and user. Define search-index ownership/rebuild lag and explicit query consistency.
design_deliverables.errors-and-side-effects: List the complete actor x read/write ACL x OCC x existing/missing matrix. One invalid batch item rolls back the batch; an integrity mismatch never returns an authorized object.
design_deliverables.concurrency-and-recovery: Define list behavior under inserts, updates and deletes, same-key different-owner ordering, cursor expiry and transaction isolation. Preserve ACL-before-limit and use deterministic mutation lock order.
design_deliverables.security-and-budgets: Authenticate actor, owner filter, collection, project/profile and last position. Bound page, batch, value bytes and query cost; define cursor key rotation and reject tampering and cross-scope replay.
design_deliverables.tests-and-compatibility: Require exact-byte version vectors, malformed/wildcard precedence, ACL and atomic batch oracle differential, cursor tamper/scope tests, concurrent pagination and both-profile fault/restart tests.
design_deliverables.operations-and-change: Define corruption alarm, index rebuild and restore validation. Publish conflict/latency/storage-growth metrics with bounded labels; schema changes require reviewed migration and rollback.

design_deliverables.scope-and-dependencies: Own leaderboard definitions/records/ranks, tournament lifecycle and reset/end scheduling. Separate scheduler ownership from reward delivery and prohibit competing active reset owners.
design_deliverables.public-api-and-examples: Document write modes, tie-break order, rank windows, list/cursor forms and period boundaries from pinned API/runtime leaves. Provide equal-score, end-boundary and deleted-record examples.
design_deliverables.state-and-data: Define period identity, deterministic score ordering, rank index, tournament membership, scheduler epoch and event/reward receipt. Archive prior periods without mutating historical winners.
design_deliverables.errors-and-side-effects: Specify closed/expired/full tournament and invalid-score precedence. A repeated reset/end trigger returns the same result; reward intent creation is transactionally tied to its unique period event.
design_deliverables.concurrency-and-recovery: Use a fenced scheduler lease and period-event uniqueness. Cover late timers, duplicate triggers, clock shifts, leader death and retry after reward commit before response.
design_deliverables.security-and-budgets: Declare rank-query, batch-write, participants-per-event and reward-fanout limits; check numeric overflow and authorization. Timezone/DST/reset semantics are profile decisions, not local-time assumptions.
design_deliverables.tests-and-compatibility: Require tie/cursor differential, exact reset/end boundaries, duplicate reward prevention, scheduler takeover, restore/replay and PostgreSQL/CockroachDB conflict tests.
design_deliverables.operations-and-change: Provide missed-trigger catch-up and audit/reconciliation procedures, scheduler lag alerts, bounded history cleanup and a migration plan preserving period and reward identities.

design_deliverables.scope-and-dependencies: Own parties, matchmaker tickets and relayed/authoritative matches with explicit per-entity ownership. Keep query core a parser subset until grammar and scoring are independently classified.
design_deliverables.public-api-and-examples: Define ticket add/remove, party roles, party-atomic matching, match join/leave/data and authoritative callback contracts. Give cancellation-vs-match and invalid-admission examples.
design_deliverables.state-and-data: Describe ticket and party membership states, match ownership generation, participant sequence, fixed-tick input queue and snapshot identity. Keep admission and assignment records restartable.
design_deliverables.errors-and-side-effects: Define terminal cancellation, no-match, stale-generation, capacity and callback failure outcomes. Matching or party admission cannot partially succeed or issue duplicate assignment effects.
design_deliverables.concurrency-and-recovery: Define fairness/starvation policy, ticket cancellation linearization, duplicate assignment rejection, match placement/fencing, overrun policy and snapshot recovery under node loss or partition.
design_deliverables.security-and-budgets: Budget tickets, query complexity, party size, matches/node, tick CPU, input/output queues and payloads; trusted session context binds every participant and rejects stale routes.
design_deliverables.tests-and-compatibility: Require grammar/scoring oracle tests, fairness load cases, atomic party matching, cancellation races, stale-owner rejection, tick overrun, node takeover and replayed-snapshot tests.
design_deliverables.operations-and-change: Document drain/rebalance, match disposition, stuck-ticket recovery and snapshot compatibility. Prove capacity under churn and preserve single-writer ownership through canary/rollback.

design_deliverables.scope-and-dependencies: Own HTTP/JSON, gRPC and gateway mapping only. Services own domain transitions; wire adapters must not import concrete database request/result contracts or execute SQL directly.
design_deliverables.public-api-and-examples: Generate bindings from pinned descriptors and enumerate routes/methods/messages/defaults/int64/null/enums/headers/status/details. Current custom authority endpoints never count as official API parity.
design_deliverables.state-and-data: Define trusted RequestContext and typed commands/results independently of HTTP or PG. One request deadline spans admission, authentication, service, repository and response handling.
design_deliverables.errors-and-side-effects: Publish complete domain-to-wire error and retry metadata tables. Authenticate privileged operations before business parsing; exact public precedence changes require profile/oracle classification.
design_deliverables.concurrency-and-recovery: Specify cancellation, partial response, deadline expiration around commit and receipt reconciliation. The listener never fabricates success from an abandoned or ambiguous transaction.
design_deliverables.security-and-budgets: Use maintained ingress/TLS/framing boundaries; specify header/body/connections/worker/queue limits, slow-client defense, admin/public isolation and debug/log secret redaction.
design_deliverables.tests-and-compatibility: Require generated-schema drift, official SDK black-box, malformed/slow request fuzz, status/header/body differential and response-loss/restart across both database profiles.
design_deliverables.operations-and-change: Supervise listeners and distinguish health/readiness. Document build/config/schema identity, graceful shutdown, certificate reload and how diagnostics avoid traversing credential-bearing objects.

design_deliverables.scope-and-dependencies: Own full JSON/protobuf RTAPI adapters and distributed connection/route lifecycle. Reuse bounded actor/router/journal candidates but do not confuse in-process transitions with socket or cluster execution.
design_deliverables.public-api-and-examples: Catalog every opcode/message/CID/error/close mapping and exact JSON/protobuf conversions. Give reconnect, unknown-field, duplicate-CID and generation-mismatch examples.
design_deliverables.state-and-data: Define connection/session/project ownership, subscriptions, producer epoch, durable revocation checkpoint and reconnect journal. Track active capacity separately from retained identity high-water state.
design_deliverables.errors-and-side-effects: Specify slow-consumer outcomes, dropped/expired frames and indeterminate disconnect effects. An accepted verifier interface is not by itself proof a transport action occurred.
design_deliverables.concurrency-and-recovery: Define restore-before-admission, delayed callbacks, stale fanout, reconnect storms, producer barriers and rolling namespace recovery. Never assume all production connections can be quiesced simultaneously.
design_deliverables.security-and-budgets: Budget active/tracked identities, per-session fanout, frame bytes, queued payload memory and pending requests. Authenticate the complete reconnect cursor and bind project/session generations.
design_deliverables.tests-and-compatibility: Require stale handle/CID reuse, full-capacity takeover, actual socket revoke, checkpoint restart, partition/failover, slow consumers and official RTAPI/SDK differential.
design_deliverables.operations-and-change: Publish saturation/ghost-route/revocation-lag alerts, rolling drain and checkpoint recovery. Benchmark full-state clone costs and forbid eviction of replay fences without a verified retirement barrier.

design_deliverables.scope-and-dependencies: Own per-profile Lua, JavaScript/TypeScript, WASM and Rust SDK hosts, RPC/hooks/jobs and Go source migration. Select engines through explicit capability, compatibility and isolation decisions.
design_deliverables.public-api-and-examples: Define initializer/module order, immutable context, null/number/string/byte/value conversion, callback results, service capabilities and error mapping for each engine ABI.
design_deliverables.state-and-data: Define module/version identity, per-invocation state, scheduler/job receipt and durable service boundary. Runtime memory is not authoritative persisted game state.
design_deliverables.errors-and-side-effects: Specify panic/trap, fuel exhaustion, timeout, host-call failure and hook rejection. Record which effects committed before failure and prohibit blind replay of effectful host calls.
design_deliverables.concurrency-and-recovery: Define cancellation across host calls, non-cooperative code containment, hot reload version pinning, callback ordering, deterministic clock/random injection and restart recovery.
design_deliverables.security-and-budgets: Bound memory, stack, fuel/CPU, wall time, output, logging and service-call quotas. Expose no unrestricted filesystem, network or raw secrets; native and sandbox profiles have separate conclusions.
design_deliverables.tests-and-compatibility: Require real Lua/JS engine observations, value/ABI differential, hook-order corpus, malicious resource programs, cancel/reload races and durable host-call response-loss tests.
design_deliverables.operations-and-change: Document module quarantine, safe reload/rollback, artifact provenance and Go capability-by-capability migration. Separate engine spike throughput from full Runtime compatibility acceptance.

design_deliverables.scope-and-dependencies: Own Console API and Rust/WASM UI workflows separately from public game traffic. Operator identities and authorization are not supplied by the candidate static administrator token.
design_deliverables.public-api-and-examples: Define the role x resource x action matrix, MFA/session flows, confirmations, export/drain/migrate/key actions and exact API/UI error states with examples.
design_deliverables.state-and-data: Define operator sessions, role assignments, approval requests and immutable audit events. Approval binds exact action parameters, target and expiry rather than reusable blanket permission.
design_deliverables.errors-and-side-effects: Authentication and authorization precede business validation. Dangerous action rejection leaves state unchanged; completed action with lost response reconciles by its durable receipt.
design_deliverables.concurrency-and-recovery: Specify concurrent role revocation, action-vs-approval changes, MFA replay, session invalidation, duplicate export and interrupted operator action recovery.
design_deliverables.security-and-budgets: Isolate bind/TLS/service identity; bound operator sessions, export size, audit and request budgets. Prevent CSRF/XSS and credential/PII leakage; require independent security review.
design_deliverables.tests-and-compatibility: Require denied-action matrices, stale/forged approvals, MFA replay, redaction, audit completeness, accessibility workflows and Console oracle/consumer differential.
design_deliverables.operations-and-change: Document break-glass containment without acceptance bypass, audit retention/export/deletion, operator recovery, rolling UI/API compatibility and key compromise response.

design_deliverables.scope-and-dependencies: Own provider adapters, wallet/metadata ownership, purchases/subscriptions/refunds and reconciliation. Keep CEX/Chain ledgers outside this repository and explicitly define only in-scope game-value ownership.
design_deliverables.public-api-and-examples: Define provider verification/callback contracts, exact account/product/environment binding, pending/approved/refunded/renewed/void states and duplicate/out-of-order examples.
design_deliverables.state-and-data: Define provider transaction identity, immutable event/receipt, subscription period and internal value-effect record. A provider transaction must not credit more than one account.
design_deliverables.errors-and-side-effects: Distinguish rejected, pending, committed, externally-applied and indeterminate outcomes. Never infer nonexecution from timeout or terminal lease expiry; no blind retry of uncertain value effects.
design_deliverables.concurrency-and-recovery: Use stable idempotency keys, authority-fenced outbox dispatch, authenticated result query, quarantine and reconciliation. Cover callback-before-request and refund-vs-renewal races.
design_deliverables.security-and-budgets: Verify callback signatures, audience/app/environment and freshness; separate provider keys. Bound retries, payloads, reconciliation batches and retention without losing transaction replay protection.
design_deliverables.tests-and-compatibility: Require vendor sandbox/hostile fixtures, replay and cross-account credit negatives, duplicate/late refunds, response-loss effects, per-profile transaction faults and official API/runtime differential.
design_deliverables.operations-and-change: Publish reconciliation backlog alerts, provider outage/revoke procedures, manual quarantine handling with dual review, receipt retention and migration/rollback disposition for unresolved transactions.

design_deliverables.scope-and-dependencies: Own Go capability/state mapping, snapshot/backfill/CDC, semantic comparison, exclusive writer transfer and final retirement. No synchronous dual-write handler or premature deletion of Go authority.
design_deliverables.public-api-and-examples: Define resumable prepare/snapshot/apply/checkpoint/compare/fence/canary/rollback operator contracts. Each operation names exact source/target/profile/schema identities and an explicit cohort.
design_deliverables.state-and-data: Define snapshot boundary, CDC position, idempotent apply receipt, ownership epoch, rollback barrier and active entity disposition for sessions, parties, tickets, matches, jobs and purchases.
design_deliverables.errors-and-side-effects: Classify schema mismatch, corrupt checkpoint, divergent value/ACL/order, missing effect and irreversible action. Failure preserves current authority; a cutover proposal is not an authorization receipt.
design_deliverables.concurrency-and-recovery: Specify crash-resume at every boundary, write fencing for existing and new sessions, split-brain prevention, reverse export and reconciliation of externally visible effects before rollback.
design_deliverables.security-and-budgets: Use least-privilege identities and synthetic rehearsal data; bound batch size, checkpoint interval, CDC lag and retention. Real production changes require authenticated independent authorization and anti-replay.
design_deliverables.tests-and-compatibility: Require clean-target restore/PITR, complete data dictionary and invariant negatives, both-profile fault/failover, canary abort/rollback, full-duration endurance and independently accepted retirement evidence.
design_deliverables.operations-and-change: Publish measured RPO/RTO, upgrade/failback and support ownership. Retire Nakama only after no traffic/writer/key/job remains, final backups and evidence are retained, and C5/retention obligations are satisfied.

Publish generation/revision/lease transition and error-precedence tables, clock assumptions and adapter fencing.
Map bounded core rotation to the existing durable response-loss/revocation path; specify history retention and socket fanout.
Specify provider normalization, trust verification, account collision and exact durable/wire adapters.
Specify all durable social/chat/notification transactions and complete committed-effect delivery.
Publish ACL/OCC/batch precedence and limits plus concurrent cursor semantics.
Publish complete repository commands/results, atomic transaction and outbox ambiguous-outcome tables.
Publish the ten-table data dictionary, every SQL ownership boundary, profile differences and recovery steps.
Publish normative byte grammar, length/order/escaping rules and exact API-to-vector mappings.
Publish full HTTP/gRPC/RT error, details, retry and close-code mapping.
Publish claim schema, validation precedence and per-profile epoch/domain/time constraints.
Publish visibility/lifecycle/error matrices and split responsibility with the route registry.
Publish supported grammar, precedence/type/missing-value semantics and complexity limits.
Publish full API and profile/error precedence; classify strictness differences with immutable oracle.
Inventory unique vectors, prove equivalent replacement coverage and define reviewed retirement.
Inventory incremental hostile cases and prove coverage equivalence before gate removal.
Specify durable checkpoints, real result verification, cross-node protocol and rolling full-capacity recovery.
Extract transport-independent service contracts, full dependency readiness, signal/drain supervision and official adapters.
Publish defaults/ranges/inter-field constraints and end-to-end elapsed retry/deadline calculations.
Publish complete message/opcode/CID and JSON/protobuf mappings with official leaf vectors.
Publish public API/byte examples and malformed/wildcard/exact-condition precedence.
Implement authenticated real provider/custody, durable lifecycle/replay/checkpoint and cross-node revoke.
Specify full format/policy/provider sequence, failure propagation and cache/revoke convergence.

component_followups.required_deliverable: Resolve all module depth gaps and dependency boundaries with specialist design review.
Map every Go package capability/state to a Rust target and a rollback owner.
Complete authoritative catalog, invariant-negative matrix and profile-specific recovery.
Reproduce immutable/instrumented and real engine observations with reviewed normalizers.
Document tool inputs/outputs and troubleshooting; reuse validators rather than invent parallel acceptance.
Maintain workflow-family runbooks, actual no-bypass readback and qualified review availability.
Complete production topology, secrets, rolling upgrade, measured RPO/RTO and endurance.
Complete retained-byte custody, authenticated review provenance and one accepted evidence cycle.

capacity_and_recovery.resource_accounting: Record steady state plus in-flight temporary clones, retained histories, checkpoints and fanout amplification. Use checked arithmetic and measure peak memory/tail latency under maximum admitted cardinality and sustained churn.
mandatory_scenarios: PostgreSQL physical PITR and application write fencing
PostgreSQL primary loss and stale-primary exclusion
CockroachDB leaseholder loss and quorum behavior
actual socket revoke and route takeover
shadow without effects and exclusive-canary rollback
capacity_and_recovery.execution_boundary: Harness presence, short runs, synthetic receipts and segmented metadata do not satisfy duration, RPO/RTO, custody or production acceptance.

completion_rule: Use only the existing exact-source/prospective, retained-evidence, gap, gate and independent-review contracts. Missing production resources or reviews remain unmet obligations; never toggle them complete.
